nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Serum for Face and Neck

avis.texte: Ive used this stuff for a year now and loved it. I saw results within weeks of first using it. But the most recent time I bought it, it was the new look…the packaging has changed, consistency/color has changed and so have the results. I used it for a month and my skin looks and feels awful…its not as ticht, wrinkles, discoloration and fine lines are more noticeable again. So now Im on the hunt for a new retinol.

I started using this retinol a year ago. I saw a huge improvement in my skin within a month…everything looked so much better. Then I finally ran out of what I had and had to buy a new look of it which claims to be the same formula but it is mot. The consistency is different. Ive been using it a month and my skin looks bad again…wrinkles and deep lines more visible. It is definitely not the same as it used to be. They ruined a good thing.

avis.titre: Literally the BEST serum I have ever used!!
avis.texte: The new Deep Wrinkle Serum is literally one of the BEST serums I have EVER used!! It feels SOOOO soft and light and airy going on my skin - like a cloud. That is the only way I can describe it! It is VERY effective - you can FEEL it working - without leaving ANY stickiness or heaviness whatsoever! This is definitely a new staple in my skincare routine, I absolutely ADORE it!

avis.titre: Formula has changed for the worst.
avis.texte: Formula has changed, it states- 'new look, same formula,' it isn't its a different colour, texure and consistency. Its more watery and leaves an oily layer on your face now! I have used this for years and its never felt like that. Awful changes.
I'm really happy tu use all of them!! I usually use them for my wrinkles and those are incredibly good! I'm from Mexico

You changed the packaging and the formula! The box and description acts like the looks are the only thing that's different, but you also changed the formula because now it's white. It wasn't white before. It's too much like the cream which dries my skin out. Please change it back! "If it's not broke, don't fix it!"

I have used probably several items from the Roc line over the past decade or two. I'm over 65 (won't say how far over) and still use and try new products. I've found Roc products always deliver great results. Thank you.
If has a weird scent. Im not sure if it's supposed to smell like that or if there's something wrong with it.
A very nice serum. It goes on smoothly and absorbs very quickly. You can just throw it on and go😄! I feel that it does help to smooth deep wrinkles, and leaves my skin very soft, not greasy.

avis.titre: I can't believe how bad it smells.
avis.texte: This smells like a wet dog that went swimming in a sewer, then was covered in moth balls and placed in a sauna. I can't believe how bad it smells. It's unusable to anyone who has a functioning olfactory system.
I am over 74 and found it too harsh for my skin. It made it irritated, red, and itchy. Instructions should say use a tiny amount of at a time to see if your skin can tolerate it.
Good entry level into retinol since it does not irritate or sting.

avis.titre: Effective on wrinkles  but overpriced at Ulta!
avis.texte: This is a great serum to soften wrinkles and help diminish fine lines but it is priced higher here than other drug stores or on the manufacturers website!
Works great but the smell…. It smells exactly like 00's jergens fake tan
Very smelly, not at all like other ROC products and I use a few of them.

Come on people, really? The smell is fine it's working on your wrinkles, what do you expect, roses and perfume? I like Roc serum, it goes on great, non greasy and at 79, I'm very pleased with the results. Thank you Roc!

Of all the skin care products I've tried over the years, this is by far the WORST stinking product I've ever worn. I couldn't bare more than an hour after going to bed to wash it off 🤢 Waste of money!

avis.titre: Seems to work well on deep wrinkles
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a month because I have deep wrinkles on my forehead, and deep smile lines around my mouth. It does not eliminate them, but they appear to be not as deep. I apply it every morning to my deep wrinkles after washing my face, followed by RoC's Hyaluronic Hydrate + Plump moisturizer. I repeat this in the evenings for 6 out of 7 days (on the 7th day I apply a glycolic acid to my face). This routine works well for me. My skin type is normal.

avis.titre: I will continue using this product as instructed.
avis.texte: It actually recommends a twelve week program for a full evaluation of results. It also recommends a slow start and a gradual build up of use. I am hopeful it will work as is stated.
Quick results., surprisingly gentle on my sensitive skin. I'll keep using to see if improvement on my fine lines., so far so good!

expensive and bad smell it burnt my neck skin so bad and itching and make it more wrinkly I used it once only made all of symptoms it's been for few days still trying to make burning and itching spot better

avis.titre: I think the one i purchased is bad!
avis.texte: The cream from the bottle is a dark orange. It looks spoiled. If it is supposed to be white or cream colored mine is definately not! What color should it be?

I bought this a few weeks ago and although it may work, the smell is awful and the color looks like pus. I decided to rmpty it and throw out. What came out was yellowish pus. They need to work on the smell and tge aporarance.

I went to replace the roc retinol capsules and the store was out of stock. I tried this serum instead and really like it. Within a few days my skin looked and felt smoother. I do use a roc moisturizer over the serum. My only complaint is the smell.
It makes my skin feel so much softer and more natural and tender. I do appreciate it.
I bought this and the scent was a big turn off. It smells Awful. I had to wash it off. Tried again no better. The scent of it is really bad. Don't know if it works couldn't use.
This stuff doesn't work. Too expensive and the bottle only lasts a couple of weeks. I used it faithfully and haven't seen any changes in my wrinkles. I will not purchase this again.
Unfortunately, I couldn't get past the first try. The smell was so overwhelming, It gave me a headache.
Honestly shocked by the smell - it has an odour like it's gone bad. Wondering why it isn't scent free.
I love this, i use it morning and night, wrinkles are slowly diminishing

avis.titre: Does what it says within days!
avis.texte: I love ALL Roc products as they deliver results! My mother asked what I was using on skin within days of using this serum!

I have just purchased this product and although I do like the way it glides and absorbs into my skin, unfortunatley the scent is so unpleasant! It smells like I've just sprayed an overally strong "grandma-esque" perfume all over my face. I can still smell it lingering on my skin as I write this review. It's a bummer because I really had high hopes about this retinol and would have liked to see if it works on my skin
After every facial cleansing this Roc deep wrinkle serum serves as a Great skin primer. Leaves my skin so smooth and subtle.
Retinol correction cream been using awhile. Love all products
Only been using for 2 weeks and already see a difference in my laugh lines.

I was looking for a retinol and this had good reviews. I'm not horribly happy with and probably won't buy it again. It feels greasy when you put it on, takes a little longer than most serums to absorb, and the smell is not good.

75% of my skin care is with Roc. I'm on my 3rd or 4th bottle of the Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Serum and have found the same discoloration occurs each time. When first using the color of the serum is a lovely light orange/mid yellow color. After about a month or so the color of serum turns dark orange and my skin has an orangish color to my skin even with a light, light application. I'm not sure if this is normal since it happens with each new purchase, but since I'm not sure I probably won't use this specific serum in the future. I really like the other Roc products.

I just bought this product, so I may have to update at the month mark. So far, so good. I like the smell. I think it smells a bit like coffee. I do think it leaves the skin nice and soft. It does say to see what your tolerance is then go up.
Bought this many times and love the results! Amazingly tightens .

I have normal skin -- not dry, sensitive, oily, etc. -- but have been trying to reverse nasolabial wrinkles. A few days of using this product has given me dry, red spots that burn like no tomorrow, especially when I sweat even a bit or put on sunscreen/moisturizer/etc. It also smells awful. DO NOT GET.

avis.titre: Percent Of Retinal Won't be disclosed
avis.texte: I was told by my dermatologist to use a serum with .5 retinal. The makers of this product will not disclose the amount of retinal used (I asked). I find it to be very concerning and deceiving that they do not due this when many other products due. My only conclusion is it is such a low percent they know people will not buy it if they knew but they want to charge the price of a high retinal product.

My first retinol. In comparison to spendier options: great for the value, smoothing of my skin texture and fine lines. Blurs imperfections. I use 4 days a week at night only, 2 days back to back, then a rest day using a heavy night moisturizer. I had to work in this product to get my skin used to it. Took about two weeks for my skin to accept the product without irritation. Worth it!

avis.titre: Gross smell self tanner mixed with bad nail polish.
avis.texte: I too,was excited to try this product, as I have liked other ROC products, but the smell is so foul. Could not even put it on my face once. Whether it works or not i will never know. The firzt time used , the smell even on my finger was bad. I rubbed it into the top of my hand and could not dare to put it on my face. What a waste, the smell is a dealbreaker.

I took a break from using this product to try other skin care. I purchased a new bottle today because I've always enjoyed this product. Did they reformulate this? The smell is terrible. Or do I have a spoiled one?

I bought this product for the first time today and have not used it yet. After reading everything on the box and on the product container, I did not see the amount that should be applied. Other serums suggest 3-4 drops all over the face. How many pumps should I use in this case?
I'm sensitive to fragrances. I can't wear this. I tried twice but it gave me a migraine both days. I really hate that because I wanted to give it a try.

I'm wondering if the smell is supposed to smell as it does. Also the color. Should it be a yellowish brown? Could it be expired???? I love the entire line and just started this but I'm a little taken aback by the smell and color.
I definitely notice when I DON'T use this! My skin feels much smoother when I do.
I use this product in the morning under my moisturizer and, it does not irritate my skin no peel.
Is this product supposed to sting? No real change in appearance of even fine wrinkles.
It's working pretty well on my 72 year old forehead wrinkles and wrinkles around the eyes. There is noticeable improvement.
It feels good on my face and meck but I haven't actually seen any change in my wrinkles. Maybe it is just keeping them from getting worse.🤔

Okay, so as someone with deep forehead wrinkles, I'm always interested in retinol serums, and I had high hopes for this particular serum but after using for 30 days, I have seen no changes. I know it's soon to notice anything but Idk, I feel like they're getting deeper? I might be looking elsewhere soon for another serum as I feel this just isn't doing much.... or enough? Anywho, maybe if you don't have like super deep wrinkles this would work but for someone with super deep wrinkles... it's not working as well.
I've only managed to use the product a few times… it smells horrible…I'll end up giving it away and finding something else.
Noticing a difference with lines around mouth and on forehead. Slight difference with line at bridge of nose.
This is the best retinol I've ever tried. I'm on my second bottle and i still love it!
I use nightly and it stings quite a bit after application. Use sparingly or every other night to start.

avis.titre: Love The Benefits, But Can't Bear The Frangrance
avis.texte: I have been using this product for approximately 1 1/2 weeks. I LOVE the improvements that I am seeing in my skin, but I find the scent unbearable. I previously used the Multi Correxion Even Tone & Lift Resurfacing serum. It had little to no scent, but the improvements to my skin did not seem as obvious as with with Deep Wrinkle Serum. Unfortunately, I just can't tolerate the scent and won't be able to continue using.
I have been using it for a long time and I enjoy its help with my skin

I am undecided on this product. I have used it multiple times and it goes on very silky and smooth. I layer it with the deep wrinkle filler and then the night cream over the top. It's always hard to know which products working when you start a new regime with all three.
Good skin results but smell of product was irritating and will have to return
Love the consistency of this cream. I do experience an initial sting but goes away quickly.
The ROC Retinol Wrinkle Serum does help my skin. With continued use, the wrinkles are less defined, giving my skin a smoother look.
It is very strong, apply only a little at a time. Or you will wind up w/ a red face. "IT DOES WORK"over time.

avis.titre: I definitely see its positive effects
avis.texte: This product is wonderful. It has definitely improved my skin I use it with ROC eye cream and daytime moisturizer .

So my husband travelled for his job and brought a ROC product back from France 30 years ago. Now it's readily available in the U. S.! I seriously get compliments on my skin all the time. Their line of skin care "holds the line on time". Start with the night serum and you will notice tighter skin, and reduction of fine lines.

avis.titre: Keeps my skin hydrated and smooth
avis.texte: I apply in the morning and it keeps my skin looking hydrated and fresh all day

Never did I imagine that I'd be throwing away the products and put RoC in place. Effects doesn't happen overnight so consistence and patience are the keys if you want something to happen. Stick to RoC and never again go back.

avis.titre: Happy with the outcome of this product
avis.texte: I've been using this product for at least six months in and have found out that it's definitely helping the look at my skin. I have sensitive skin and it's working for me.

avis.titre: Takes a while to see results
avis.texte: This is just ok. It takes weeks to see results and I have to say the smell is not the greatest.

I been using ROC products for years and I love them! I decided to order something a little different to treat some deeper wrinkles that I have noticed. Got this product today. It stinks! Like really smells horrible!

Oh, I love this stuff. I am already seeing a difference in my cruise feet, and some of the lines above my forehead. It's a very very silky, feeling type of product without feeling oily, which I love. I'll definitely buy again.
Very gently on my skin, a big improvement. Minimum wrinkles.
I have been using them now for free for years. I have try other products, but I seem to come back to this one because I like it. I am 68 year old,, go into my budget.

Have been using for 1 week & already see a big difference. From the very first time I tried it on my face it made my skin feel so velvety soft I couldn't stop touching it! Can't wait to see more results!

My dermatologist suggested this product years ago. And if I run out and don't keep using yet, I notice that my face does not look as healthy. Great product that is reasonably priced. I highly recommend it.
I really love this product. It feels light on my skin. I started to see results in 2 weeks.

avis.titre: Roc Serum, Retinol Correxion n plump serum capsule
avis.texte: I'm 85. I HAVE USED Retinol Correction for many years as well ascthe cspsules. The new Setum this year. I have always taken care of my skin. I truly believe in thes products and i have been asked out by men betw 60 n 65. I think this says a lot about this product.

avis.titre: Compared to many retinol serums i have tried...Roc
avis.texte: This serum is definitely the perfect final touch for my facial care routine.
I believe this seems to be working. When I ran out and delayed re-ordering, the wrinkles started to become more visible. Now that I'm back on the regimen, I seem to look much younger.
This works better than anything else I have tried. Not too harsh on my skin either.
I love ROC's retinol serum. And their Eye Creme is the best I have ever used. ver used

avis.titre: Perfect...if it wasn't for the silicones!
avis.texte: I used this on one side whilst applying the ROC Retinol night cream on the other side of my face for a clear comparison between the two. I built up my skins' tolerance level which is something I suggest anyone new to retinol should do, by applying every 3rd day, then every 2nd and eventually nightly. I prefer the light texture of this to the night cream and that it doesn't sit on my skin but sinks in quite easily. Retinol does work! Even in the short amount of time that I used it my pores looked more refined and my skin tone overall fresher and smoother. However, with 3 types of silicones in the formulation that joy was short-lived. By day 10 I was already breaking out, despite the gaps in between use. Bottom line: if your skin does not like silicones, then go with a Retinol product that doesn't list 'Cyclopentasiloxane' or 'Dimethicone' in its ingredients list. And if silicones aren't an issue, then count yourself lucky, as it's one of the more cost-effective Retinol formulas out there! -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Huge difference in my skin this has been by far my favorite nightly routine and I'm just 38, but I live in the south and wrinkles from sun damage in my youth had left me and my face feeling older this has def rewound the clock on my face.

avis.titre: Start using this when you're young.
avis.texte: I've been using ROC retinol (n various forms) since I was 30. I'm 65 now, and there is not a line on my face. I also use sunscreen, btw. This stuff is amazing.

avis.titre: Be patient and you will be rewarded!
avis.texte: I have used this serum for many years and it has definitely helped keep my skin looking young. Don't expect immediate results. Keep using it each evening and over time you will see noticeable results. I am regularly told I look at least 10 years younger than I am.

avis.titre: my husband said I smelled like an old woman
avis.texte: works great smells like moth balls and potpourri.... I'm really disappointed cause it's a great product, great price point, but I have to switch because of the smell.
This sermon is great. Ive tried just about everything and i love the results i am seeing

probably too soon to see any results but goes nice not oily at all. Because it's retinol it makes your skin a little red and sensitive that's what retinol does...just don't apply it every day. The smell is different, really don't care for the smell but I'm not going to let the product and my money go to waste. P.S USE SUNBLOCK
I have used the Roc products for years. I am now 92 years old and I'm told that I look like I'm 70.
I have always had wonderful results with all the ROC products.

avis.titre: RoC Deep Wrinkle Serum is the BOMB!
avis.texte: I have very deep wrinkles on my forehead. I used this product for several years and then decided to try other products just to see how they compare. Hands down! If you have deep wrinkles, RoC Deep Wrinkle serum is for you. Give it some time and you will see a difference. For me it was a big difference. This works!
It works! I've been using it for years and people can't believe it when I tell them my age.
I'm not sure I can continue using because of the fragrance. It's just so strong and doesn't smell the best. I was really looking forward to trying this.

Love this product! This is a product that my dermatologist recommended years ago. I use it every day and it's just amazing how much it helps my skin! There are times when I have run out and I don't go get the product for another two weeks and my skin starts to look dull. It is truly my #1 go to product that I use every day. I would highly recommend it. All you need is a couple drops a day to put on your face and your neck.
Amazing product!!! The only product I've tried that actually does what it claims to do! I saw results in 2 days!! Again I say AMAZING
I am happy to support the Roc Products. I am realllt happy with everything that l use from Roc products.

I love the creaminess. The feel of the cream. I have been using for about 2 months and I can see a difference. I will be 60 on the 10th of January. Leslie in Miami, Texas

Works wonderful on my skin. I'm 71 years old and this works wonders on my skin. I have a few wrinkles and this helps make my face look so much younger!

Plus it's gentle for a retinol product which I love because I have slightly sensitive skin and don't like the stronger stuff for everyday use that makes my skin peel. My skin looks and feels healthier, softer and rejuvenated. People says I don't look 65 years old and I look being in my 50's .

Seems to be working great with only a few uses. Lines in my cheeks are dimenishing
